evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; adds UNIX domain socket support to the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli via -rpcbind and -rpcconnect.
rationale: Adds UNIX domain socket support to the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli, closing a feature request open since 2014 (#5029). Operating system filesystem permissions can now govern RPC access without requiring loopback IP allowlists or incurring TCP overhead, addressing a long-standing integration gap for local services.
